buildBlocker: This workspace is aarch64-apple-darwin. `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` bundles `nsis` and `msi` only, and `scripts/tauri.mjs` only enters its release path when `process.platform === 'win32'`, so the installers this project ships cannot be produced here.

The updater signing key `~/.pulsewin-signing/updater.key` does not exist on this machine and `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY` is unset. `updater.requireSignedVersion` is true, so a package built without it could not be accepted by any installed client, and the key must not be regenerated (docs/updates.md: losing it ends update signing for installed users).

`scripts/publish-github.mjs` uploads `updates/github/{exe,sig,msi,msi.sig,latest.json}`, which only `npm run tauri -- build` on Windows creates. Publishing a Release without `latest.json` would 404 the endpoint every installed client reads (`releases/latest/download/latest.json`) and break update checks, so no Release was created.
toFinishOnWindows: git pull, then `npm run tauri -- build` — builds and signs 0.1.18 at the version already committed here, and publishes the local `updates/latest.json` feed because releaseHold is now false
`npm run publish:github` — pushes main, creates the draft Release, uploads the five assets, then publishes
Do not run `npm run release`: it bumps the patch version again and would skip 0.1.18.
